import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    "Qwen-rw": [0.9956, 0.6955, 0.5893, 0.5435, 0.5340],
    "Pythia":   [0.9932, 0.6539, 0.5514, 0.5152, 0.5136],
    "OLMo":     [0.9970, 0.6145, 0.5496, 0.5091, 0.5045],

}

    "Qwen-rw":   dict(color="#1f77b4", linestyle="-",  marker="o"),
    "Pythia":     dict(color="#ff7f0e", linestyle="--", marker="s"),
    "OLMo":       dict(color="#2ca02c", linestyle="-.", marker="^"),
    "Qwen-cont":  dict(color="#d62728", linestyle=":",  marker="D"),
}

def compute_kstar(auc_list, theta):
    k = 0
    for auc in auc_list:
        if auc > theta:
            k += 1
        else:
            break
    return k
